title: How Alvin Ailey came to her Mass
summary: Peter and Brother John Sellers pushed her and Ailey toward the ballet.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts

blocks.x: What brought you and Alvin Henry(?) together?

Peter, and Brother John. Peter went to all the ballets. He thinks everything I do is so great. I said, one day you're going to be disappointed. He said, you should do a ballet. He went to all the ballets trying to get me do something. After he found out that Katherine Dunham dance one of my things - I said, "Peter, I don't want to be with the ballet." He kept running around so after a while he met Brother John Sellers. John Sellers started pushing with him and the next thing I knew - well you see, Alvin Ailey is the type of person that you could tell him about a lot of things but he has to find it himself, so it seeped in and the minute it seeped in, oh my goodness, I couldn't get rid of him. "Oh, we've got to do this! Oh, I'm going to do this with you!" He went to, he just had a fit and started bragging and going on about the ballet. But Peter did that. He just kept going back because see, I had to train him. I said, "Now I've

been away a long time. It's just like me coming out fresh but you have a better chance because I did have a little name when I stopped." So I told him some things to do and he caught on fast on his own.
